content: List my rides from the last two weeks, then pull the full details of the hardest one and tell me what stands out.

| Metric | Value |

**Did it go well?** It was clearly the biggest training stimulus: the highest Load and more than twice the duration of either earlier ride. There isn’t enough information about your goal or RPE to judge execution quality.

**What stands out?** The recorded distance is exactly 30 km on all three rides despite very different durations. That may be correct, but it’s worth checking for incomplete distance or sensor data. No lap breakdown was returned.

**What does this mean for the next session?** The activity record alone doesn’t establish recovery, so I wouldn’t alter your next session without your post-ride feel or wellness data.
